T: Keep moving forward. Duck the meatballs.
D: An orphan inventor is whisked into the future by a boy called Wilbur and meets the very odd Robinson family.
P: Serve the mains when Uncle Gaston fires the meatball cannon at dinner.
S: Lewis's peanut butter and jelly bites
Crustless bread with peanut butter and strawberry jam, cut into small triangles
Little sandwiches of white bread with peanut butter and strawberry jam, crusts cut off, cut into triangles and stacked high.
Science fair chicken nuggets and dips

Chicken breast nuggets in crunchy parmesan panko, baked golden and served with three test tube dips: honey mustard, barbecue and garlic aioli. Cut 600g chicken breast into nugget pieces. Dust in 50g plain flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs, then coat in 150g panko mixed with 30g grated parmesan and 1 tsp paprika. Lay on a lined tray, spray with oil and bake at 220C for 15 minutes, turning once, until golden. Mix 2 tbsp honey with 2 tbsp Dijon and 2 tbsp mayo. Serve with that, barbecue sauce and garlic aioli in small glasses.
Small pizza rounds with sauce, mozzarella, pepperoni and oregano
Pizza dough rolled thin, cut into rounds, topped with tomato sauce, mozzarella and pepperoni, baked at 220C for 10 minutes.
M: Beef and pork meatballs simmered in tomato and basil, over spaghetti
Beef and pork meatballs browned and simmered 40 minutes in tomato and basil sauce, piled over spaghetti for the whole wild family.
Todayland chicken tacos with lime slaw
the bright future city of Todayland

Chicken thighs grilled with lime and chilli, tucked into soft tortillas with slaw, avocado and crema. Marinate 700g chicken thigh with the juice of 1 lime, 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 crushed garlic clove and oil for 30 minutes. Grill 5 minutes a side and slice. Toss a quarter of a red cabbage, finely shredded, with the juice of 1 lime, coriander and salt. Mix 150g sour cream with lime zest and a pinch of salt for crema. Warm 12 small flour tortillas and fill with chicken, slaw, sliced avocado and crema.
W: Vanilla cupcakes piped with bright buttercream
Vanilla cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, piped with bright buttercream and a little arrow on top.
K: Frozen red grapes, banana, grape juice and vanilla yoghurt
Frozen red grapes blended with banana, grape juice and vanilla yoghurt until thick and purple.

note.text: Keep moving forward, Lewis. Mistakes teach you more than wins ever do.

dishes.n: Lewis's peanut butter and jelly bites

steps.text: Spread the bread with butter, peanut butter and jam.
Slice each sandwich into four small triangles and stack on a plate.
Heat the oven to 220C. Roll the dough thin and cut into small rounds.
Top each with sauce, grated mozzarella, a slice of pepperoni and oregano.
Mix the minces with parmesan and egg, roll into balls.
Add the tomatoes and torn basil and simmer.
Cook the spaghetti and pile the meatballs on top.
Heat the oven to 175C and line a muffin tin. Beat the butter and sugar, then the eggs, then fold in flour and milk.
Beat the buttercream with colouring and pipe on top. Add a little icing arrow to each.
Wash the grapes and pull from the stems.
Blend with the banana, grape juice and yoghurt until thick.
Pour into four glasses and serve with straws.

s.n: Lewis's peanut butter and jelly bites
s.note: Crustless bread with peanut butter and strawberry jam, cut into small triangles
s.how: Spread white bread with butter, peanut butter and strawberry jam. Cut off the crusts and slice each sandwich into four small triangles. Stack them high on a plate. Simple, but an inventor needs fuel.

s.note: Small pizza rounds with sauce, mozzarella, pepperoni and oregano
s.how: Roll pizza dough thin and cut into small rounds. Top each with pizza sauce, grated mozzarella, a slice of pepperoni and a pinch of oregano. Bake at 220C for 10 minutes until crisp and bubbling. Delivered from outer space.

m.note: Beef and pork meatballs simmered in tomato and basil, over spaghetti
m.how: Mix 300g beef mince and 300g pork mince with parmesan and an egg, roll into balls and brown. Add 2 cans crushed tomatoes and torn basil and simmer 40 minutes. Pile over 500g spaghetti for the whole wild family.

w.note: Vanilla cupcakes piped with bright buttercream
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, then 2 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake at 175C for 18 minutes and cool. Pipe bright buttercream on top and add a little icing arrow pointing forward on each.

d.note: Frozen red grapes, banana, grape juice and vanilla yoghurt
d.how: Freeze 500g red grapes overnight. Blend with 1 banana, 250ml grape juice and 200g vanilla yoghurt until smooth and thick. Pour into 4 glasses and serve straight away with straws.
